 Elizabeth Holmes, the subject of the new documentary You Can See Everything .
 Fraud vs. Fraud 
 Sympathy for Elizabeth Holmes
 Anna Delvey considers Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s portrait of a fraudulent founder
 By Anna Delvey 
 Photo illustration by Chop Choppish Shop 
 October 24, 2026 
 Reading Time: 5 minutes 
 T he past week has felt a lot like 2017 for me, except now I have better hair and a hard-earned ankle monitor. Since the release of Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s documentary, You Can See Everything, it feels like I’ve been tagged in more posts about Elizabeth Holmes than Elizabeth Holmes, who in fairness is indisposed and without an Instagram account.
 There was the BuzzFeed quiz “Are You More Anna Delvey or Elizabeth Holmes?” (That wasn’t the first article that linked us. Back in 2018, the Outline published a piece arguing that we shared a “tell”: split ends.)
